_comment_source: The dump itself is NOT in this repository and must not be put in it: this remote is public, and the request titles carry people's names. Export tab I1 of Attachment C.3 to CSV and place it beside this file, or point REQUEST_DUMP at it.
_comment_columnMap: Tab I1 as the client exports it. Two of these are worth knowing about. There is no category or sub-category column at all, which is why requests are not filed the way incidents are. And the column holding the timestamp is headed 'Year' — the values are Excel date serials, so the heading is the client's mistake rather than ours, and the loader reads the values rather than trusting the name.
